body.title: Summarize top ten country populations
body.goal: Open https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries_by_population_(United_Nations). For each of the first twenty countries in the table, open its article and record the population figure and the year it was reported. Then summarise the ten largest.

result.output_text:
The twenty article figures are saved in [outputs/country_population_infoboxes.csv](outputs/country_population_infoboxes.csv). The ten largest by those recorded figures are:

| Rank | Country | Population | Reported | Source |
|---:|---|---:|---|---|
| 1 | India | 1.48 billion | 2026 estimate | [Article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/India) |
| 2 | China | 1,404,890,000 | 2025 estimate | [Article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/China) |
| 3 | United States | 341,784,857 | 2025 estimate | [Article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States) |
| 4 | Indonesia | 290,125,073 | 2026 estimate | [Article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indonesia) |
| 5 | Nigeria | 242,747,130 | 2026 estimate | [Article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nigeria) |
| 6 | Pakistan | 241,499,431 | 2023 census | [Article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pakistan) |
| 7 | Brazil | 214,211,951 | 2026 estimate | [Article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brazil) |
| 8 | Bangladesh | 179.3 million | 2026 estimate | [Article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bangladesh) |
| 9 | Russia | 146,028,325 | 2025 estimate | [Article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russia) |
| 10 | Ethiopia | 138,902,185 | 2025 estimate | [Article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ethiopia) |

These figures come from article infoboxes, not a single common reference year, so the ordering can differ from the UN table. India’s figure is rounded; Russia’s listed estimate includes Crimea.
